plugins.description: Clawd's pixel world above your prompt, in four scenes that follow your local time, season and holidays: Clawd walks to the zone of whatever Claude is doing while his crew plays, and acts out what happens: tests, commits, pushes, permission asks, a library that fills with the context. A Clawd spinner, live usage figures, the to-dos Claude hands you, and a deadline radar. English and 繁體中文.
